title: Place and resize a rectangular review annotation
preconditions: Open greeting slide in pr-1 with annotation toolbar and a writable review.

steps.action: Choose Rectangle and drag from 32%,28% to 62%,58%; enter a comment and save.
steps.expected_result: A visible rectangle annotation with normalized numeric coordinates is saved.

steps.action: Select its stroke and drag the resize handle outward.
steps.expected_result: Saved width and height both increase.

expected_result: Saved width and height both increase.
